name: qiksy-bridge
description: Browser MCP for the Chrome you already have open, with your logins: snapshot, fill whole forms in one call, click, screenshot, read console and network errors. Needs the free Qiksy Bridge extension.

token.title: Qiksy bridge token
token.description: From the Qiksy extension popup: Agent bridge (MCP) On, then Generate. Leave empty if this computer already trusts the browser (npx qiksy-mcp trust <token> or npx qiksy-mcp connect).
